tools.name: validate_query
tools.description: Free. Check and normalize a company name or domain before calling lookup_victim; tells you whether it will be searched as a domain or a name. Offline: no network request, no payment.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Return the price of every paid tool, the payment network (Base) and address, the licensed data sources, and the 'unverified claim' label every result carries. No input, no network request, no payment.

tools.name: lookup_victim
tools.description: Search ransomware leak-site claims for one company name or domain: has a group claimed it? Returns matching claims with group, claimed date, first-observed date, country, sector and licensed sources. Use it for a single vendor or target; use batch_exposure_check for a list of up to 25 vendor domains

tools.name: recent_claims
tools.description: List the newest ransomware leak-site claims (1-10), optionally filtered to one group such as akira or qilin. Use it to watch recent activity; use lookup_victim to search for a specific company. Only commercially reusable sources are used, so country and sector are often null. Every result is an unve

tools.name: group_profile
tools.description: Get a profile of one ransomware group: aliases, when RansomLook first observed it, and a sample of its newest claims. Use it to understand who a group is; use recent_claims for a longer list of its latest claims. Unknown groups return an error and are not charged. Every claim is an unverified claim

tools.name: batch_exposure_check
tools.description: Check up to 25 vendor or supplier domains in one call for ransomware leak-site claims, for third-party-risk reviews. Returns one result per domain (found, claim count, claims with group, dates and sources). Domains only; use lookup_victim for company names. At most 15 claim records are read per batc

Raw claims only; use vendor_risk_report for risk levels, a summary and actions. Every result is an unverified claim from a crim

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "validate_query" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Free. Check and normalize a company name or domain before calling lookup_victim; tells you whether it will be searched as a domain or a name. Offline: no networ…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: batch_exposure_check, vendor_risk_report, indicator_check, watch_status · Private data: batch_exposure_check · Public sink: indicator_check, watch_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: batch_exposure_check, vendor_risk_report, indicator_check, watch_status · Private data: batch_exposure_check · Public sink: indicator_check, watch_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
